reserveReview.rationale: The only located issuer reserve claim is a December 2021 launch FAQ that describes parts of the product and validation API in future tense. The issuer product URL is unavailable in this review, no current composition or assurance report was found, and the Arbitrum token remains live. The historical cash design cannot support a verified 2026 composition.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Evidence-blocked: launch-era issuer design plus current onchain token existence, with no current reserve report
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: All current reserve assets, balances, banking counterparties, safeguarding terms, assurance status, and redemption liquidity are unverified.
